name: Banco BPM
description: Banco BPM is an Italian commercial bank serving retail, small business and corporate customers through about 1,400 branches, mainly in northern Italy, and is listed on Borsa Italiana.

name: Cloud Capital
description: Cloud Capital is a Washington, D.C.-based investment manager affiliated with CloudHQ that buys and operates data centers for institutional investors, having acquired about 30 data center assets since 2020.

name: TerraPower
description: TerraPower is a Bellevue, Washington nuclear company developing the Natrium sodium-cooled reactor for utilities and large power buyers, with its first commercial plant under construction in Kemmerer, Wyoming.

name: Howard Hughes Holdings
description: Howard Hughes Holdings is an NYSE-listed real estate company that develops master planned communities such as The Woodlands, Bridgeland and Summerlin, selling land to homebuilders and leasing commercial property.

name: Constellation Brands
description: Constellation Brands is an NYSE-listed producer and importer of beer, wine and spirits, including Corona and Modelo, selling mainly to US distributors and retailers, with about $10 billion in revenue.

name: lsomorphic Labs
description: Isomorphic Labs is a London-based Alphabet spinout from DeepMind that uses AI to discover drugs, partnering with pharma firms Eli Lilly and Novartis, and raised $2.1 billion in 2026.

name: Marriott International
description: Marriott International is a Nasdaq-listed hotel company that manages and franchises about 9,800 properties under more than 30 brands in 145 countries and territories for business and leisure travelers.

name: Sagard
description: Sagard is a Montreal-based alternative asset manager investing in venture capital, private equity, private credit and real estate for institutional and private investors, with about $46 billion under management.

name: Butterfly Net
description: Butterfly Network is an NYSE-listed medical device company in Burlington, Massachusetts, selling handheld ultrasound probes and AI imaging software to hospitals and clinicians in about 20 countries.

name: Aypa Power
description: Aypa Power is an Austin-based, Blackstone-owned developer and operator of utility-scale battery storage and hybrid renewable projects for US power markets, backed by a $1.5 billion credit facility.

name: Chaos
description: CHAOS Industries is a Los Angeles defense company building radar networks that detect drones, missiles and aircraft for military and government customers, valued at $4.5 billion in 2025.

name: Phoenix Tailings
description: Phoenix Tailings is a Woburn, Massachusetts company that refines rare earth metals and alloys from mined ore and recycled magnets for manufacturers, operating facilities in Massachusetts and New Hampshire.

name: Commercial International Ba
description: Commercial International Bank is Egypt's largest private-sector bank, serving retail and corporate customers through more than 200 branches, and is listed on the Egyptian Exchange.

name: Yankee Global Enterprises
description: Yankee Global Enterprises is the Steinbrenner family holding company that owns the New York Yankees and a stake in the YES regional sports network, serving fans, broadcasters and advertisers.
